description.p: OpenSSL Encrypt is a comprehensive encryption tool that provides military-grade security with cutting-edge post-quantum cryptography. Protect your files against both current and future quantum computing threats.

ul.li: Multiple symmetric encryption algorithms (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, Fernet, etc.)
Post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM, HQC, Kyber) for quantum-resistant protection
Advanced password protection with multiple KDF options (Argon2, PBKDF2, Scrypt)
Secure file operations with military-grade secure deletion
Comprehensive cryptographic hash support (SHA-3, BLAKE2b, Whirlpool)

description.p: Perfect for individuals and organizations requiring the highest levels of data protection, including protection against future quantum computer attacks.
To report bugs or request features, send email to: issue+world-openssl-encrypt-2-issue-+gitlab@rm-rf.ch

New PIV / PKCS#11 HSM backend (--hsm piv) that derives the key-derivation pepper from a PIV private key on a smart card, and source-code integrity protection (verify-integrity) backed by a PGP-signed SHA-512 manifest. New ASCII armor output (encrypt --armor) writes paste-safe PEM-style Base64 with CRC-24 truncation detection, auto-detected on decrypt. Encrypt-to-self now adds the sender as a recipient by default so senders can decrypt their own outbound files (opt out with --no-encrypt-to-self).

Security dependency update: urllib3 2.7.0, cryptography 46.0.7, pillow 12.2.0, idna 3.15 — fixes for CVE-2026-44431/44432, CVE-2026-39892, a PSD decoder out-of-bounds write, and an idna DoS. New CI check keeps flatpak dependency pins aligned with the package requirements.

Security hardening release: authenticated keystore format, D-Bus polkit authorization, fail-closed PQC algorithm resolution, plugin sandbox enforcement, per-drive USB salts. New: cross-device YubiKey/OnlyKey HSM decryption, encrypt-CLI reconstruction from file metadata via the info action, Diceware passphrase generation, HSM-aware derive-password. Threefish extension builds on Python 3.14. Requires Python 3.11+.
Fix Flutter GUI launcher in Flatpak: corrected binary name so --gui flag works correctly.

Desktop GUI Simple/Pro mode toggle — Simple mode (default) hides all advanced options and uses the modernized STANDARD template. New defaults: SHA3-512 + BLAKE3 hashes, RandomX + Argon2 KDFs, cascade encryption (AES-256-GCM + ChaCha20-Poly1305), Independent XOR (v11) key derivation. Dependency bumps: cryptography 46.0.6, requests 2.33.0, black 26.3.1, nltk 3.9.4.

Streaming chunked AEAD encryption (format v12) for constant-memory large file handling, full Windows compatibility, stderr output separation, comprehensive security hardening, and dependency security updates.
Security dependency update: bumped nltk to 3.9.3 (CVE-2026-33236, CVE-2026-33231, CVE-2026-33230, GHSA-rf74-v2fm-23pw).
Streaming chunked encryption (format v12), Windows compatibility, stderr output separation, and security hardening.
